title: Churn Recovery & Customer Retention
description: Diagnose account health issues and proactively win back unhappy customers. Tests churn prediction, win-back flows, and relationship management.

seo.overviewTitle: Customer Churn Recovery & Retention Save Playbooks
seo.overviewBody: Customer retention directly protects Recurring Revenue (MRR/ARR). Retention managers and CS specialists demonstrate value by analyzing churn survey data, creating proactive intervention playbooks for at-risk accounts, structuring discount save offers, and tracking Net Revenue Retention (NRR).

deliverables.title: 1. Customer Churn Intervention Playbook
deliverables.desc: Action playbook defining early churn warning signals, outreach triggers, and personalized save scripts.

deliverables.title: 2. Exit Survey Analysis & Churn Root Cause Report
deliverables.desc: Analytical report categorizing cancellation reasons (pricing, missing features, poor support) and strategic recommendations.

deliverables.title: 3. Customer Win-Back Campaign & Offer Tree
deliverables.desc: Structured offer tree detailing discount save permissions, pause options, and automated win-back email sequences.

faqs.question: What are early indicators of customer churn risk?
faqs.answer: Declining login frequency, sudden drop in core feature usage, open high-severity support tickets, unassigned user seats, and change of internal project sponsor.

faqs.question: How do you calculate Net Revenue Retention (NRR)?
faqs.answer: NRR = ((Starting ARR + Expansion ARR - Contraction ARR - Churn ARR) / Starting ARR) * 100. NRR above 100% indicates net revenue growth even without acquiring new customers.

faqs.question: How should save offers be structured without devaluing the product?
faqs.answer: Offer temporary account pauses, free training, or feature add-ons before offering price discounts, reserving discounts for validated budget-conscious accounts.
